reason: Document history row dated April 27, 2023 states S3 automatically enables Block Public Access and disables ACLs for all new buckets in all Regions; FAQ and object-ownership page confirm both defaults.

Default encryption FAQ states: from January 5, 2023 all new uploads are encrypted at no additional cost, and SSE-S3 is applied to all new buckets and to existing buckets without default encryption; existing SSE-S3/SSE-KMS configs unchanged.

Quotes cover signature in URL, bucket/key/method/expiry inputs, exact match of method, headers and query string, query-string modification causing mismatch, and the service denying a non-matching signature.

Managing delete markers page states deleting the marker with its version ID removes it permanently, simple GET then returns the prior version, the most recent non-current version becomes current, and a DeleteObject without version ID PUTs another delete marker.
